# Easel

Easel is an offline-first personal whiteboard. Its browser app is available at /app and the administrator console at /admin.

To install a new instance for a user, follow the agent installation guide. It covers deploying with Docker, creating the administrator account (the first account on a server), opening /admin and /app for the user, and verifying the instance.

- Agent installation guide: https://github.com/niltavi/easel/blob/main/docs/en/for-agents.md
- Copy of the guide on this site: /for-agents.md
- Source: https://github.com/niltavi/easel
- Deployment reference: https://github.com/niltavi/easel/blob/main/docs/en/deploy.md
